command:
find /work -name AGENTS.md -o -name CLAUDE.md -o -name AI_POLICY.md -o -name CONTRIBUTING.md -o -name Cargo.toml -o -name rustfmt.toml -o -name .rustfmt.toml -o -name clippy.toml -o -name rust-toolchain.toml -o -name rust-toolchain -o -name '*.rs'
cat /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/references/documentation.md
ls -la /work/crate
for f in /work/AGENTS.md /AGENTS.md /work/crate/Cargo.toml /work/crate/src/lib.rs; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; fi; done

cd /work/crate && find . -maxdepth 4 -type f -print
sed -n '1,240p' /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/scripts/check.sh
RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bash /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/scripts/check.sh /work/crate
